pitwall_ptt.text: GT7 doesn't send wheel button presses, so Pitwall can't see your wheel. Talk to Pitwall with the iPad's talk button, or hold Space on a keyboard.

not_on_wheel.label: ABS
not_on_wheel.text: GT7's stability control (ASM) and ABS are only in the pause menu, under Assistance Settings. They can't go on a button.

not_on_wheel.label: Stability control
not_on_wheel.text: GT7's stability control (ASM) and ABS are only in the pause menu, under Assistance Settings. They can't go on a button.

not_on_wheel.label: Wing
not_on_wheel.text: Wing angles are a setup item in every game researched. F1 25 2026 cars switch Active Aero to Straight Line Mode on the DRS/S Mode button inside the zones only; other games have DRS on cars that have it.

not_on_wheel.label: Ride height / weight jacker
not_on_wheel.text: No game Pitwall knows lets you change ride height while driving. F1 25 and GT7 only show it in the car setup; iRacing's weight jacker on some oval cars is the closest thing.

not_on_wheel.label: Flashback / rewind / reset
not_on_wheel.text: GT7 has no rewind button; Retry is in the pause menu.

not_in_game.label: Pit limiter
not_in_game.text: GT7 has no pit limiter button: the pit lane is automatic.

not_in_game.label: The game's own push-to-talk
not_in_game.text: GT7 has no push-to-talk of its own.
